svg.title: Mount Pleasant Rd (Eglinton Ave E to Blythwood Rd)
svg.desc: Map of Mount Pleasant Rd (Eglinton Ave E to Blythwood Rd), 1.1 km, highlighted in blue. Subway stations: Eglinton. Other cycling routes on Broadway Ave, Duplex Ave, Edith Dr, Eglinton Park Trl, Glengrove Ave W, Montgomery Ave, Roselawn Ave, Rosewell Ave and Sherwood Park Trl. 2 collisions where someone was killed or seriously injured happened within 30 m of this stretch in the last 5 years (a total, not individual incidents).
svg.text: 2 fatal or serious-injury collisions (30 m, 5 years)
